title: Storage Rental Terms of Description, Access and Availability
content:
Every Storage Rental product is rented as described by its catalogue entry, is open during that product's access hours, and, when no unit of the product is free, is waitlisted or declined according to that product's waitlist term.

## What the rental includes

A Storage Rental unit is rented exactly as its product's catalogue describes it:

- its interior width by its interior depth, with its stated clear ceiling height;
- climate controlled or not, as the product states;
- reached from an interior corridor when the product opens onto an interior corridor;
- behind the product's door type, at the product's location (bike room, garage level or interior corridor);
- with a 120-volt outlet and with fixed shelving only where the product says so;
- in a bike locker, up to the product's stated number of bicycles;
- with no more than the product's maximum floor load in pounds per square foot.

## Access

The storage area is open during the product's access hours (either 06:00 to 22:00 or 24 hours), and a storage access card is issued without charge when the product includes one.

## When no unit is free

| Product's waitlist term | No unit of the requested product is free |
|---|---|
| Waitlist allowed | The request is waitlisted |
| Waitlist not allowed | The request is declined |

All six Storage Rental products — the Bike Storage Locker, the Small Storage Closet (4x4), the Standard Storage Unit (5x5), the Large Storage Unit (5x10), the Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) and the Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) — currently allow a waitlist, so a request for any of them when no unit is free is waitlisted.

## Basis questions

**Does a Storage Rental come with a power outlet?** Only where the product says so. Among the six products, that is the Oversized Storage Suite (10x10).

**Does a Storage Rental come with shelving?** Only where the product says so: the Small Storage Closet (4x4) and the Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10).

**How many bicycles may be kept in a Bike Storage Locker?** Up to the locker's stated capacity of 2.

**Is there a charge for the first access card?** No, where the product includes an access card; every Storage Rental product currently does.
